samples.summary: Line-number citations in the docs (e.g. 'selection.ts:112', 'text-editor.ts:2021') describe a pre-fix snapshot of the code; after the fix landed the referenced lines no longer correspond to the described defect (line 112 in selection.ts is now a blank line before a doc comment, and line 2021 in text-editor.ts is unrelated header/footer logic, not a shift+click else-arm). This is consistent with these being historical investigation notes rather than claims about the current tree, but a reader following the citation into the current file will be misled about where to look.
